slice: P2 AC1027 consumed-style MLINE offset edit with cap-suppression flags
scope: Permit one selected AC1027 direct consumed-style offset edit for a two-element MLINESTYLE while preserving MLINE group-71 flags 5, 9 or 13 and reprojecting the affected per-vertex group-41 values.

specEvidence.group41: Element parameters describe per-element segment intersections, starts and cuts. Cap suppression is carried separately in group 71.
specEvidence.interpretation: The selected direct edit changes the first style offset from 1.25 to 1.5, preserves the second offset, and recomputes the two open consumers' per-vertex parameters. Preserving group-71 cap bits does not qualify native cap rendering.

contract.admission: AC1027 only, direct edit of a source-bound consumed MLINESTYLE with exactly two elements and an offset-only style change. The selected nondefault MLINE group-71 values 5, 9 and 13 are admitted. Closed value 3 and unknown-bit value 17 refuse. MLINESTYLE flags remain 2.
contract.projection: For the authored offsets [1.25,-0.75] → [1.5,-0.75], preserve two MLINE consumers (ENTITIES and BLOCKS), their vertex geometry and group-71 flags, and emit exact per-vertex group-41 parameters for both elements. Group 49 style offsets, group 71 entity flags and group 41 parameters are checked in physical output and fresh typed readback.
contract.outputAndReadback: Twelve positive combinations cover flags 5/9/13 × ASCII/binary input/output. Physical output checks exact group 49 offsets, group 71 flags and group 41 values for both consumers. Fresh readback verifies style offsets, entity flags, geometry, miter data and typed parameters.
contract.failureAndRetry: Closed and unknown group-71 profiles each refuse for both output encodings while preserving a destination sentinel and caller state; corrected flag-13 sources then succeed through the same adapter. A late consumer-parameter mutation refuses without replacing the destination and succeeds on the same adapter after restoring caller state.
contract.compatibility: The nondefault-cap admission is restricted to the selected AC1027 direct consumed-style two-element offset-edit path. Plain group-71=1 offset edits, cap-flag append/removal, and offset/angle retarget selectors also pass. Other offsets, cap combinations, style counts, routes, versions and native cap appearance remain outside this receipt. All source/output files are runtime-generated; no drawing fixtures were committed.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp generates the source MLINESTYLE and two MLINE records at runtime. The output proof checks physical group codes and freshly imports serialized output.

focusedSelectors.summary: 6/6 selected tests passed. The new selector covers 12 positive encoding/flag profiles, 4 closed/unknown refusals with same-adapter retry, and 2 late-mutation refusals with same-adapter retry; plain consumed-offset, cap-flag append/removal, and offset/angle-retarget regressions pass.

validation.asan: NOT_RUN; this slice adds no new allocation, ownership, lifetime, bounds or handle path.

limitations: Only the selected AC1027 direct consumed-style two-element offset edit with group-71 flags 5, 9 and 13 is covered.
Group-71 values are preserved and read back, but native cap appearance and rendered geometry are not qualified.
Other offset values, cap combinations, versions, carriers, full document closure and format support claims remain outside this receipt.
